item.title: AI Takes Over 3D Printing: ORNL's Real-Time Correction and More
item.description: Oak Ridge National Lab's AI system corrects 3D printing errors in real time—but is it really lights-out? Plus, Norsk Titanium inks a production contract with Northrop Grumman, Decathlon's Kiprun launches a 3D printed running shoe, and an IPO that smells like biotech hype. We dig into the week's additive manufacturing news and separate signal from noise.
